_comment_why: Test-only typecheck config — VO-MCP-CLEAN-BUILD-HARDENING-PR-1. The production tsconfig.json excludes `src/**/*.test.ts` so `bun run build` stays closed over Node runtime types. This config re-includes the test files and adds Bun runtime types so `bun test` source is still type-checked by `tsc --noEmit`. Runs explicitly via `bun run typecheck:test` — `bun test` itself does not consult either tsconfig for file discovery or strict checking.
